questions.question_text:
The angle is drawn to scale.
What is its measure?
[tikz]
\begin{tikzpicture}[every node/.style={font=\large}]\usetikzlibrary{angles}\coordinate(V)at(0,0);\coordinate(A)at(4,0);\coordinate(B)at(42:4);\draw(A)--(V)--(B);\pic[draw,angle radius=0.8cm]{angle=A--V--B};\end{tikzpicture}
[/tikz]

options.why: The opposite protractor scale was read instead of the scale starting at zero.
The exact protractor reading was rounded to the nearest ten degrees.
The two digits in the correct reading were reversed.

questions.solution_text: With the centre at the vertex and the base at zero, the other arm reads $42^{\circ}$.

questions.question_text:
A ray crosses paired protractor readings $71$ and $109$.
The starting arm is at $0$ on the scale increasing toward $71$.
What is the angle?

options.why: The scale ending at the wrong zero was used.
The two paired readings were subtracted from each other.
The paired scale readings were added together.

questions.solution_text: Use the scale that starts at $0^{\circ}$ on the base arm, giving $71^{\circ}$.

questions.question_text: Which setup rule is essential when measuring an angle?

options.text: Place the centre on the vertex and the zero line on one arm.
Place the straight edge across both arm tips.
options.why: The arm tips do not locate the angle's vertex or zero direction.

options.text: Place the centre anywhere along the longer arm.
options.why: The centre must be on the vertex, not elsewhere on an arm.

options.text: Always read the larger of the two scale numbers.
options.why: The correct scale depends on which one starts at zero.

questions.solution_text: The centre belongs on the vertex and the $0^{\circ}$ line must align with one arm.

questions.question_text:
The smaller angle between two rays measures $76^{\circ}$.
What is the reflex angle?

options.why: The smaller angle was subtracted from 180 rather than 360 degrees.
The digits in 76 were reversed before subtracting from 360.
The smaller angle was reported instead of the reflex angle.

questions.question_text:
A protractor gives paired readings $34$ and $146$.
The marked angle is obtuse.
Which measurement is correct?

options.why: The acute paired reading was chosen despite the angle being obtuse.
The two printed readings were subtracted unnecessarily.
The paired readings were added, producing a straight angle.

questions.solution_text: An obtuse angle is greater than $90^{\circ}$, so the correct reading is $146^{\circ}$.

questions.question_text:
Tom and Katie are arguing about the size of the marked reflex angle.
Tom says it is $150^\circ$.
Katie says it is $210^\circ$.
Who is correct?

options.why: Tom reads the smaller supplementary angle rather than the marked reflex angle.
The marked region is reflex, so it has one unique measure rather than both values.
The reflex angle is $360^\circ-150^\circ=210^\circ$, matching Katie.

questions.solution_text: The smaller angle is $150^\circ$. The marked angle is the reflex angle, so its size is $360^\circ-150^\circ=210^\circ$. Only Katie is correct.
